recentItems.title: Algeria's Gymnastics Star! Kaylia Nemour's Vault at Paris 2024 🤸‍♀️🇩🇿
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live #Paris2024! ➡️ https://oly.ch/3REmN8s

Algeria’s Kaylia Nemour’s journey in gymnastics began in France at 4 years old but quickly progressed. In 2023, she won silver at the World Championships in Antwerp. At Paris 2024, she made history by winning the gold medal on the uneven bars with 15.700 points. This was the first Olympic gold medal for Algeria in artistic gymnastics and the first for an African gymnast. Nemour, who previously competed for France, had switched her sporting citizenship to Algeria due to differences with the French Gymnastics Federation.

recentItems.title: One month to go until the Dakar 2026 Opening Ceremony! ⭐
recentItems.description:
The Youth Olympic Flame arrives in Africa for the first time as Dakar’s young dancers bring its journey to life through movement, music and vibrant Senegalese energy. Watch the flame pass from hand to hand in a powerful celebration of youth, unity and Olympic spirit on the road to the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games.
